verdict.rationale: Flagsmith has a public pricing page (flagsmith.com/pricing) that lists plan features such as SAML/SSO, 2FA, and 'Unlimited Feature Flags ... Unlimited Environments'. That tells a product manager that flags and environments are not cost drivers. The pack contains no price figures and no metering dimensions, so the actual cost drivers cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: published price points per tier, explicit cost drivers (seats, MAUs, requests, events), overage terms, and independent corroboration of pricing clarity.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
